entries.text: # Handover: Mont Ventoux small observatory, instrument and data operations
entries.label: Handover: Mont Ventoux small observatory, instrument…

entries.text: The observatory operates a 60-centimetre reflector installed in 2017 and a 20-centimetre refractor used for public outreach.
entries.label: The observatory operates a ##-centimetre reflector…

entries.text: Useful nights average 195 a year; 2024 had 168 because of an unusually wet autumn.
entries.label: Useful nights average ### a year;…

entries.text: Data volume is about 400 gigabytes a month, archived to a university server in Marseille with a nightly transfer that takes 40 minutes.
entries.label: Data volume is about ### gigabytes…

entries.text: The main camera was replaced in March 2025 after its cooling system failed twice; the new sensor has 30 percent lower read noise but requires a firmware update the team has not yet applied, because the update requires taking the instrument offline for a full night.
entries.label: The main camera was replaced in…

entries.text: In 2023 a dome rotation motor seized during a session and the telescope tracked into the dome wall, bending a counterweight rod; the rod was replaced and a limit switch added.
entries.label: In #### a dome rotation motor…

entries.text: In February 2025 three weeks of photometry were lost because a timestamp offset of 1.2 seconds went unnoticed after a clock synchronisation change; timestamps are now checked against a GPS reference at the start of every session.
entries.label: In February #### three weeks of…

entries.text: Rules in force: no observation runs during public outreach evenings, because the 2023 incident happened while both were scheduled together.
entries.label: Rules in force: no observation runs…

entries.text: Raw frames are never deleted, only compressed after two years.
entries.label: Raw frames are never deleted, only…

entries.text: Any change to the acquisition software requires a test night before production use.
entries.label: Any change to the acquisition software…

entries.text: A collaboration with a Spanish observatory for simultaneous observations was proposed in 2025; it depends on a shared scheduling tool that nobody has evaluated.
